0.headline: Five drafts, zero points, one hundred fourteen up for grabs
0.overview: Pre-season, and the scoreboard is a beautiful blank slate: five drafts, zero points apiece, every castaway still breathing, and 114 on the table for all of them. Tami, drafting first in the snake, opened with Jelly at #1 and stacked five bodies including the leftover Sharonda at #21, though only her best four count. Taylor grabbed Kristin at #2, Kylie took Aaliyah at #3, Tim scooped Lewis at #4, and Austin, picking last, doubled up immediately with Linnea and Jenna at #5 and #6. Different shapes, identical starting line. Let's see whose blueprint holds.

lines.text: Austin sat at the back of the snake and cashed in with back-to-back picks Linnea and Jenna, then closed with Carter and Eric for a 4-of-4 roster nobody can call thin.

Kylie's "Chef, Counsel & Chaos" runs Aaliyah at #3, Cristian, Alexis and Kilby — a chef, an HR head, a defense attorney and a game designer, which sounds less like a tribe and more like a hostage negotiation.
Tami used the first overall pick on Jelly and then quietly hoarded five castaways through Rob at #20 and Sharonda at #21, knowing only her best four will ever count.
Taylor went crisis management at #2 with Kristin, 49, then layered in Ori, Ana and Brady the pro wrestler — chokeslams and voice acting, all still in.
Tim took Lewis at #4 and Maggie at #7 — two farmers, no apologies — then balanced the barn with Devin and Thien An.

awards.label: Boldest draft
awards.text: Tami is carrying five castaways when only four score, betting that depth beats precision.

awards.label: Safest draft
awards.text: Tim built "Two Farmers and a Bus" on Lewis, Maggie, Devin and Thien An — no gimmicks, all four still in.

1.headline: Four tied at the top, one torch already snuffed
1.overview: Family, after one episode this draft is a logjam — Austin, Tami, Taylor and Tim all sitting on 4 pts, all plus-four, all with 110 on the table and every single name still breathing. Austin and Tim share the top draft GPA at 3.75, Tami's five-deep roster at 3.6 means only her best 4 count, and Taylor's 3.5 crew came through clean. Then there's Kylie at 3 pts with a 3 GPA, 3 of 4 still in and 85 on the table, because Aaliyah went home first. One vote separated the pack. That's all it takes.

lines.text: Austin, a 3.75 GPA and Eric stolen at #16 to the top rank — that's cattle, cameras and counseling all paying rent.
Tami, you grabbed Sharonda with leftover pick #21 and she's already a rank-1 steal — the Idol Whisperer badge is earning itself.
Taylor, Brady at #19 turned a whisper about aggression into a mission, and your 3.5 GPA roster is four-for-four intact.
Tim, two farmers, a bus, a 3.75 GPA and Thien An as a #17 steal — quietly nobody's touched your names.
Kylie, you wear First Blood for Aaliyah at #3 becoming rank 21, but Kilby at #18 is a rank-1 steal and 85 is still on the table.

awards.label: Draft of the week
awards.text: Top GPA at 3.75, a rank-1 steal in Eric, and all four in — the cleanest night on the beach.

awards.label: Ouch of the week
awards.text: The very first torch snuffed belonged to your #3 pick, and that's 3 pts instead of 4.
